record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:74 — The check-then-insert on attendees is not atomic and the server does not dedupe the guests input, so concurrent or duplicate submissions can create duplicate attendee rows

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the handler reads current attendees (prisma.booking.findFirst include attendees), computes `uniqueGuests` by filtering only against existing attendees/blacklist, then inserts with `attendees.createMany`. The input schema `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` and the `uniqueGuests` computation do not dedupe duplicates within the `guests` array itself, so a payload like `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` can create duplicate rows. Additionally, because the existence check and insert are separate operations, concurrent requests can both pass the check and insert the same attendee email, yielding duplicates unless there is an unseen DB-level unique constraint.
